gap_details.2011-2012: RECONSTRUCTED (phase 2) from PubMed/Europe PMC affiliations, NPPES enumeration dates and other programs' pages; no program-side roster exists (see phase-1 host audit). Only 2 residents known (Alcedo-Guardia, Estronza-Ojeda). The 2006-2008 and 2011 entry classes are unidentified (the last section roster is a stale ~2006-07 list; everyone on it probably finished by 2011-12, but Lincoln Jimenez, PGY-3 in a 2008 footnote, may still have been a resident). Anyone who left in these years would be unseen.
gap_details.2012-2013: RECONSTRUCTED (phase 2) from PubMed/Europe PMC affiliations, NPPES enumeration dates and other programs' pages; no program-side roster exists (see phase-1 host audit). 4 known (2009, 2010 and two 2012 entrants); the 2007/2008/2011 classes are unidentified.
gap_details.2013-2014: RECONSTRUCTED (phase 2) from PubMed/Europe PMC affiliations, NPPES enumeration dates and other programs' pages; no program-side roster exists (see phase-1 host audit). 5 known; the 2008 and 2011 classes are unidentified (would be PGY-6 and PGY-3).
gap_details.2014-2015: RECONSTRUCTED (phase 2) from PubMed/Europe PMC affiliations, NPPES enumeration dates and other programs' pages; no program-side roster exists (see phase-1 host audit). 7 known; the 2011 class (PGY-4) is unidentified, and the 2013 entrant Pellot is only probable.
gap_details.2015-2016: RECONSTRUCTED (phase 2) from PubMed/Europe PMC affiliations, NPPES enumeration dates and other programs' pages; no program-side roster exists (see phase-1 host audit). 9 known; the 2011 class (PGY-5) is unidentified. The entry years of Estronza (2010) and Pellot (2013) are NPI-based estimates.
gap_details.2016-2017: RECONSTRUCTED (phase 2) from PubMed/Europe PMC affiliations, NPPES enumeration dates and other programs' pages; no program-side roster exists (see phase-1 host audit). 9 known; the 2011 class (would be PGY-6) is unidentified. The 2016 entrant Monserrate is placed by NPI only.
gap_details.2017-2018: RECONSTRUCTED (phase 2) from PubMed/Europe PMC affiliations, NPPES enumeration dates and other programs' pages; no program-side roster exists (see phase-1 host audit). 10 known, covering every entry class from 2012 to 2017 (2 per class in 2012, 2014 and 2015, 2 in 2017). Entry years for the transferees are inferred (NPI or destination PGY), and some may be off by one year. No PubMed UPR-neurosurgery author in 2016-2019 is left without a role (the rest are faculty, fellows, students or international trainees).
gap_details.2018-2019: RECONSTRUCTED (phase 2) from PubMed/Europe PMC affiliations, NPPES enumeration dates and other programs' pages; no program-side roster exists (see phase-1 host audit). 11 known, every class 2012-2018 represented. Same caveats as 2017-18.
gap_details.2019-2020: RECONSTRUCTED (phase 2) from PubMed/Europe PMC affiliations, NPPES enumeration dates and other programs' pages; no program-side roster exists (see phase-1 host audit). 10 known, every class 2013-2019 represented. Flores-Milan's last UPR year (left for USF, PGY-5 there 2020-21).
gap_details.2020-2021: RECONSTRUCTED (phase 2) from PubMed/Europe PMC affiliations, NPPES enumeration dates and other programs' pages; no program-side roster exists (see phase-1 host audit). 9 known: two graduates (Rios-Vicil, Mayol) and 7 residents who all transferred out in June/July 2021 (USF, Arizona, Pitt, AGH x2, MCW, Brown). Each transfer is confirmed on the destination roster.
gap_details.2021-2022: No resident known. ACGME withdrew accreditation effective 2022-06-30 (14 citations; UPR GME 'Status de Acreditacion 2021' PDF). All 7 known in-training residents left by July 2021, and no UPR-neurosurgery author in 2021-22 PubMed is a resident. Residual risk: Pellot (probable 2013 entrant) may have finished in June 2022 instead of 2020, and a 2021 intern cannot be ruled out, although a match into a program under withdrawal is unlikely.
gap_details.2022-2023: NO PROGRAM: accreditation withdrawn eff. 2022-06-30; new program Initial Accreditation eff. 2025-07-01 (ACGME list). Presumed zero residents; not counted as missing.
gap_details.2023-2024: NO PROGRAM: accreditation withdrawn eff. 2022-06-30; new program Initial Accreditation eff. 2025-07-01 (ACGME list). Presumed zero residents; not counted as missing.
gap_details.2024-2025: NO PROGRAM: accreditation withdrawn eff. 2022-06-30; new program Initial Accreditation eff. 2025-07-01 (ACGME list). Presumed zero residents; not counted as missing.
gap_details.2025-2026: First year of the new program (1 position). Vazquez-Medina is PGY-2 in its second year, so she must have been the PGY-1 in 2025-26. No capture exists.
gap_details.2026-2027: OBSERVED live 2026-09-27: 2 residents (PGY-1 Rivera Rivera, PGY-2 Vazquez-Medina). Page created 2026-06-03 (before July); no earlier version exists, labels fit a 2025 first class.

problems: No program-side roster exists for 2010-2026, so every old-program year is a reconstruction. Entry years come from NPI enumeration dates (checked against 3 fellowship-dated graduates) or destination PGY, and are uncertain by +/-1 year. Classes entering 2006-2008 and 2011 are unidentified, which leaves 2011-12 through 2016-17 significant. 16_adjudicate labelled Matos Cruz 'TRANSFERRED (University of Louisville)' through an ambiguous-name match outside this program's data; the destination is Allegheny (training_history row). Destination-side transfer-in rows (USF, Arizona, Pitt, AGH, MCW, Brown) were not inserted, because this agent may write only program 101 rows. Europe PMC was down (503) for part of the session; rerun succeeded. Common Crawl, phase 2: 2015-2018 rescanned with cclocal; the old failures 2015-11, 2016-30, 2017-39/neurosurgery and 2018-47 now succeeded with no roster hits. New failures: 2015-06 (both prefixes), 2015-22, 2016-44 and 2017-39 (/surgery/neurosurgery). 2020-2022 scan: 66 pairs ok, no rosters; failed 2020-05, 2020-24, 2021-10 (gme), 2021-21, 2021-49.
